description: Parts Velocity opens with its Location filter set to All locations, so the first thing a user sees is every location they can reach, mixed together. It is meant to open on the one location they are working in.
steps: Sign in as a user with access to more than one location and check the location shown beside your name at the top right — here it read Staging Heavy Duty - 9919, on an account that can also reach Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
Open Reports, then Parts Velocity, for the first time in this browser — a private window guarantees there is no saved view.
Read the Location filter at the right-hand end of the filter row, and read the Location column in the table.
current:
The filter reads All locations and the table returns rows from both locations — BRAKECLEAN appears once for Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and again for Staging Lethbridge - 4310.

It is not a remembered setting: the browser held no saved view, the page's first request carried no location at all and the second carried both. Choosing a single location works correctly, so only the starting value is wrong. Both locations are ones this user is allowed to see.

For triage: the same starting behaviour on Inventory Value is SV-8931. This ticket is Parts Velocity, which has its own requirement wording.
expected: On a first visit the Location filter is set to the user's currently active location — the one selected in the application's location switcher — and they can widen it from there.
source: The toolbar provides a Location multi-select filter as the rightmost control in the filter row, listing the locations the signed-in user has access to plus an "All Locations" option. On a first visit it defaults to the user's currently active location (the location currently selected in the application's global location switcher).
